tickets.title: US001
tickets.description:
As a Student,
I want to register using my university email,
so that only university members can access the marketplace.

Acceptance Criteria:

- Registration requires a .edu email.
- Verification email is sent.
- Non-.edu emails are rejected.

tickets.title: US002
tickets.description:
As a Student,
I want to scan item barcodes,
so that product details can be filled automatically.

Acceptance Criteria:

- Camera opens successfully.
- Barcode is detected.
- Product information is populated automatically.

tickets.title: US003
tickets.description:
As a Student,
I want to create auctions,
so that buyers can compete for my item.

Acceptance Criteria:

- Seller can start an auction.
- Users can submit bids.
- Highest bid wins when auction closes.

tickets.title: US004
tickets.description:
As a Student,
I want to select a safe exchange zone,
so that I can meet buyers safely.

Acceptance Criteria:

- Safe zones are displayed on a list.
- One zone must be selected before chat.
- Selection is saved.

tickets.title: US005
tickets.description:
As an Administrator,
I want to manage safe exchange zones,
so that students use approved meeting locations.

Acceptance Criteria:

- Admin can add zones.
- Admin can edit zones.
- Admin can remove zones.

analysis.ambiguity1:
Requirement:
This needs to be exclusive.

Explanation:

The term "exclusive" is unclear because it does not define exactly who may use the system. It is unclear whether access should be restricted to current students only, faculty members, alumni, or anyone with a university email address.
analysis.ambiguity2:
Requirement:
Safe Exchange Zones

Explanation:

The requirement does not specify how exchange zones are defined, maintained, approved, or updated. It is unclear how many zones should exist and who manages them.
analysis.conflictSolution:
Conflict:

The Student Union wants to collect a 2% transaction fee.

The University Legal Team states that the university cannot process payments.

Proposed Solution:

The platform will not process financial transactions.

Users will complete payments using external services such as Venmo, bank transfer, or cash.

The Student Union may generate revenue through premium listing services instead of transaction fees.
